name: Fadhil Khalid
headline: Business Operations Architect | Business & Information Architecture | Operational Systems
masterStatement: I connect how a business works with the information and systems it depends on—turning fragmented operations into clarity, alignment and decisions people can trust.
summary: Business Operations Architect with an engineering foundation, working across business architecture, information architecture, operational intelligence and digital systems. I start by understanding how work actually happens: the processes, people, decisions, data and dependencies behind an operating function. I connect separately maintained information, reconcile definitions and relationships, identify gaps, and design practical systems that preserve functional ownership. I combine data modelling and integration with hands-on workflow, automation and application design. I evolve existing systems through controlled, minimum-change improvements—considering data quality, schema changes, backward compatibility and downstream impact—rather than rebuilding without need.

principles.title: Establish shared meaning

principles.title: Evolve, don't rebuild by default
principles.text: Preserve what works. Make controlled changes to data structures and workflows while considering quality, compatibility and downstream effects.

principles.title: Design for sustainable use
principles.text: Connect business context, information architecture and practical technology so the system reduces friction instead of creating more work.
